tools.name: pick
tools.description: Pick the live paid endpoint for a need: price, rail and a live 402 check ($0.005 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Say what you need ("transcribe audio", "search tweets") and get up to 5 live paid endpoints: url, method, price_usd, network, description, input_example, live_402_checked_at, price_matc

tools.name: recipes_top
tools.description: Top paid-API recipes (best per task, or top N for one task) ($0.002 per call, paid via MPP on Tempo). Say what you need ("transcribe audio", "check a token before buying", "search tweets") and get ranked, live-checked recipes with exact call details. Defaults to "search the web". findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pick, recipes_top, recipes_find, recipes_get · Private data: recipes_top, recipes_find, recipes_get · Public sink: pick, recipes_top, recipes_find, recipes_get.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pick, recipes_top, recipes_find, recipes_get · Private data: recipes_top, recipes_find, recipes_get · Public sink: pick, recipes_top, recipes_find, recipes_get

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
